candidates.hypothesis: Replacing the failed four-leg SPY iron condor with one defined-risk bull put credit may retain the long-term equity-drift thesis while halving leg complexity and removing the losing call side.

rules.entry: Sell one 30-45 DTE SPY put at 0.15 target delta (0.10-0.22 band) and buy one put exactly $5 lower; live-delta provenance and at least $0.50 net credit are required.
rules.exit: Take profit at 25% of credit, stop when loss reaches 200% of entry credit, force exit by 7 DTE, and allow no discretionary exit before 24 hours.
rules.risk: One contract per structure, at most one new structure per day, at most two concurrent structures, paper only, and block unless filled broker orders plus active successor journals explain every live option leg.
rules.regime: Validation hypothesis only; no edge or North Star contribution is claimed before the clean promotion gate passes.

candidates.hypothesis: A 3-Bucket passive distribution engine combining Section 1256 option-income ETFs (SPYI, QQQI, JEPQ: 55% weight at ~10% yield), qualified dividend compounders (SCHD, DGRO: 30% weight at ~3.4% yield), and cash reserves (SGOV, USFR: 15% weight at ~5% yield). Replaces the $2.5M capital requirement of pure dividend growth with a $600K target capital structure generating $6,000/mo net cashflow without forced share liquidation during bear markets (implemented in src/strategies/income_bucket_engine.py).

rules.universe: Bucket 1: SGOV/USFR (15%); Bucket 2: SPYI/QQQI/JEPQ/DIVO (55%); Bucket 3: SCHD/DGRO (30%)
rules.entry: Systematic DCA allocation via IncomeBucketEngine.plan_rebalance_dca; directs deposits into underweight buckets first.
rules.exit: Passive monthly cash distribution payouts; 0 discretionary sales of Bucket 2/3 shares during market pullbacks.
rules.risk: Bucket 1 maintains 12 months of living expense buffer, insulating portfolio against sequence-of-returns drawdowns.
rules.regime: Passive multi-asset distribution; active accumulation phase scales capital toward the $600,000 North Star threshold.
